scripts.start: node scripts/kill-ports.js 3000 5000 && concurrently "npm run start-backend" "npm run start-frontend"
scripts.start-backend: cd backend && set PORT=5000&& npm start
scripts.start-frontend: cd frontend && set PORT=3000&& npm start
scripts.dev: node scripts/kill-ports.js 3000 5000 && concurrently "npm run dev-backend" "npm run dev-frontend"
scripts.dev-backend: cd backend && set PORT=5000&& npm run dev
scripts.dev-frontend: cd frontend && set PORT=3000&& npm run dev
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
